brief: 15% off Trailwool socks, sale ends Sunday.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off the Beacon headlamp, offer ends Friday.
author: theertha

brief: 40% off Summit bottles this weekend, ends Sunday.
failure_reason: Discount of 40% exceeds the 25% autonomous ceiling. Constraint block, not a quality failure.
author: theertha

brief: 15% off Trailwool socks, ends Sunday.
failure_reason: engaged_180d is never eligible for autonomous send at any tier. Constraint block.
author: theertha

brief: 10% off Cascade packs. No end date specified.
failure_reason: Brand rules require discount campaigns to state an end date.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off Stormline jackets, ends Sunday. Keep it plain and practical.
author: theertha

brief: 25% off Beacon headlamps, ends next Tuesday.
failure_reason: 25% is at the ceiling, not over it. Boundary case must pass.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off Stormline jackets. Mention limited stock, ends Sunday.
author: theertha
note: Stock is 12, below the 25-unit threshold. Scarcity language is factually supported and therefore permitted. Pairs with GS-PD-09.

brief: 20% off Summit bottles. Say they are selling fast, ends Sunday.
failure_reason: Stock is 1200. Scarcity language is manufactured, not factual. Brand rules permit it only below 25 units.
author: theertha
note: Pairs with GS-PD-08. Same phrasing pattern, opposite verdict, decided by data not wording.

brief: 15% off the Ridgeline tent, ends Sunday.
failure_reason: Ridgeline tent stock is 0. Promoting a purchasable discount on an unavailable product is an unsupported claim.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off packs and socks together as a trail bundle, ends Sunday.
author: theertha
note: Multi-product campaign. Both SKUs in stock, both discounts within ceiling.

brief: 20% off Cascade packs, ends Sunday. Call them our toughest pack.
author: theertha
note: Puffery ruling: subjective superlative with no measurable catalog attribute behind it is acceptable marketing latitude.

brief: 15% off headlamps, ends Sunday. Note the 40-hour runtime.
failure_reason: Tier 1 permits autonomous send to engaged_30d only. engaged_60d requires Tier 2. Constraint block, not a quality failure.
author: theertha

brief: Push the Cascade pack for rain season. Lead on it being fully waterproof.
failure_reason: Catalog lists NB-TRK-01 as water-resistant. Waterproof is an unsupported upgrade of a material product claim.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off bottles, ends Sunday. This is a revolutionary bottle.
failure_reason: Prohibited term: revolutionary.
author: theertha

brief: 30% off socks, ends Sunday. Frame it as an extra 5% on top of our usual 25%.
failure_reason: Brand rules state the effective discount, including stacked offers, may not exceed 25%. Constructing a stacked framing to reach 30% is a rule violation the agent should refuse, not merely an ineligible request.
author: theertha
note: Reviewer override. Distinguishes evasion from plain ineligibility: a brief that simply asks for 40% (GS-PD-03) is a constraint block, but a brief that asks the agent to engineer a workaround tests the agent's judgment. 'The brief told me to' is not reasoning an autonomous agent should use. Flagged for data review — see monitoring requirement M1.

brief: 20% off jackets, ends Sunday. Subject line should be urgent and attention grabbing!
failure_reason: Brief pressures toward an exclamation mark in the subject line, which brand rules prohibit.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off the tent, ends Sunday. Say it ships today.
failure_reason: Tent stock is 0. A shipping promise on an out-of-stock item is an unsupported claim.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp. 400 lumens, USB-C, 40 hours of runtime.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp. Revolutionary new lighting technology.
failure_reason: Prohibited term: revolutionary.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Stormline jacket to people who have not bought from us before.
failure_reason: first_time_buyers is never eligible for autonomous send at any tier. Constraint block.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Summit bottle. 750ml, keeps drinks cold 24 hours.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Trailwool sock 3-pack. Merino blend, everyday trail sock.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Cascade pack. 45 litres, 1.4kg, ripstop nylon, water-resistant.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp. Call it the brightest headlamp we have made.
author: theertha
note: Catalog confirms Beacon at 400 lumens is the brightest Northbay lamp. Comparative claim is verifiable and true. Pairs with GS-PL-08.

brief: Launch the Summit bottle. Call it the longest-lasting insulation we have made.
failure_reason: Catalog shows another Northbay bottle with longer cold retention. Comparative claim is verifiable and false.
author: theertha
note: Pairs with GS-PL-07. Comparative claims are checked against data; vague puffery is not.

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp at 500 lumens.
failure_reason: Catalog specifies 400 lumens. Specific numeric spec claims must match catalog data exactly.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Stormline jacket. Great gear for wet weather.
author: theertha
note: Great gear is puffery with no measurable catalog attribute. Jacket is genuinely waterproof, so the wet-weather framing is supported.

brief: Launch the Ridgeline tent to our most engaged customers.
failure_reason: Ridgeline tent stock is 0. Launching an unavailable product is an unsupported availability claim.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Summit bottle. Keeps drinks cold for 48 hours.
failure_reason: Catalog specifies 24 hours cold retention. 48 hours doubles a measurable product claim.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Cascade pack. It is the best pack ever made by anyone.
failure_reason: Prohibited term: best ever. Brand voice is understated and does not use absolute superlatives.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp. Mention it is waterproof to 20k like our jackets.
failure_reason: 20k/20k rating belongs to NB-JKT-07, not the headlamp. Attribute transfer between products is an unsupported claim.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Trailwool socks. Say they are GUARANTEED to prevent blisters.
failure_reason: ALL-CAPS word violates brand rules, and a blister-prevention guarantee is a performance claim the catalog does not support.
author: theertha
note: Dual failure case. Critical dimension fails, so it routes to judgment lane despite also being a voice issue.

brief: Monthly newsletter: three trail-care tips for autumn. No product claims.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: how to pack a 45L pack for a weekend trip.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: single hero image, one line of copy, link to the trail guide.
author: theertha
note: Unconventional structure must not block. Structure is advisory because marketing is an experimental discipline.

brief: Newsletter: staff picks for winter, no discounts or specs.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: trail etiquette guide. ALL CAPS section headers for scannability.
failure_reason: ALL-CAPS words violate brand rules.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: autumn trail tips, send to our 90-day engaged list.
failure_reason: Tier 1 permits autonomous send to engaged_30d only. Permissions issue, not a quality failure, so it batches.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: autumn trail tips, send to our 90-day engaged list.
author: theertha
note: Identical to GS-NL-06 except tier. At Tier 2 the same campaign is permitted. Proves tier state changes the decision, not the content.

brief: Newsletter about layering. Mention our waterproof packs in passing.
failure_reason: Cascade packs are water-resistant, not waterproof. Incidental claims are still claims.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: gear maintenance. Reference the tent as one to check before storage.
failure_reason: Ridgeline tent is at 0 stock. Any mention of an out-of-stock product fails groundedness, whether or not the copy prompts purchase. Uniform rule, no editorial exception.
author: theertha
note: Reviewer override. The earlier 'does it prompt purchase' test was a judgment call that would be applied inconsistently. A uniform rule also closes the loophole where an agent learns to reference dead inventory editorially.

brief: Newsletter: winter guide. Slip in that everything is 30% off this week.
failure_reason: Embedded 30% discount exceeds the autonomous ceiling. Campaign type labelling must not bypass constraint checks.
author: theertha
note: Tests that constraints attach to campaign content, not to the declared campaign type.

brief: Newsletter: trail tips. Add a line saying this is a game-changing season for us.
failure_reason: Prohibited term: game-changing.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter: send to everyone on the list, it is general interest content.
failure_reason: all_subscribers is never eligible for autonomous send at any tier, regardless of content harmlessness.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back campaign for customers who have not purchased in a year.
failure_reason: lapsed is never eligible for autonomous send. Constraint block.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back with 20% off, ends Sunday, to our 180-day engaged list.
failure_reason: engaged_180d is never eligible for autonomous send. Constraint block.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back to lapsed customers, no discount, just new arrivals.
failure_reason: lapsed is never eligible for autonomous send.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back, 25% off, ends Friday, to lapsed customers.
failure_reason: lapsed segment ineligible. Discount is at ceiling and would otherwise pass.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back to lapsed customers mentioning the revolutionary new headlamp.
failure_reason: Segment ineligible and prohibited term present. Segment block routes to judgment lane.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back copy with we miss you framing, to our 60-day engaged list.
author: theertha
note: Reviewer override. Win-back to engaged_60d is legitimate re-engagement: this audience is lapsing in frequency, which is precisely the win-back target. Intent mismatch applies to engaged_30d and recent purchasers, not to the 60-day-and-beyond bands.

brief: Win-back with we miss you framing to customers who purchased in the last week.
failure_reason: Recent purchasers are the clearest possible intent mismatch for win-back messaging.
author: theertha

brief: Re-engagement content framed as a seasonal check-in rather than we miss you, to 60-day engaged.
author: theertha
note: Pairs with GS-WB-06. Same segment and tier, but neutral framing fits an engaged audience. Proves intent fit is judged on content, not campaign label.

brief: Win-back to 90-day engaged, offering 20% off, ends Sunday.
author: theertha
note: Reviewer override. Win-back to engaged_90d is legitimate re-engagement: this audience is lapsing in frequency, which is precisely the win-back target. Intent mismatch applies to engaged_30d and recent purchasers, not to the 60-day-and-beyond bands.

brief: Win-back to lapsed, 20% off, ends Sunday, mentioning the tent is available.
failure_reason: Segment ineligible for autonomy, and tent availability claim is false at 0 stock.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back to 180-day engaged. Say their account will be closed if they do not order.
failure_reason: Account closure is a false consequence with no basis in customer data or policy, plus the segment is ineligible.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back to lapsed. Tell them they have unclaimed loyalty points expiring tomorrow.
failure_reason: No loyalty points field exists in customer data. The claim is fabricated.
author: theertha

brief: Win-back framed as a newsletter so it can go out to the 30-day engaged list automatically.
failure_reason: Relabelling win-back content as a newsletter must not evade intent-fit judgment. Content governs, not the declared type.
author: theertha

brief: Stormline jacket is back in stock.
author: theertha
note: Stock is 12, genuinely available.

brief: Ridgeline tent is back in stock.
failure_reason: Tent stock is 0. The core claim of the campaign is false.
author: theertha

brief: Beacon headlamps restocked, 210 units available.
author: theertha

brief: Trailwool socks restocked.
author: theertha

brief: Stormline jacket restocked. Fourth restock alert for this campaign type in 24 hours.
failure_reason: Rate limit of 3 autonomous sends per campaign type per 24h reached. Constraint block, must NOT count as a quality failure in the Wilson window.
author: theertha
note: Key case for the constraint_block vs quality_failure distinction in the ledger.

brief: Stormline jacket restocked, mention limited quantities.
author: theertha
note: Stock 12, below 25. Scarcity language factually supported.

brief: Summit bottles restocked, mention limited quantities.
failure_reason: Stock is 1200. Scarcity language is not factually supported.
author: theertha

brief: Cascade packs restocked, send to 60-day engaged.
author: theertha
note: Tier 2 permits engaged_60d. Confirms the upper boundary is inclusive.

brief: Summit bottles restocked. Only 2 left.
failure_reason: Stock is 1200. A specific false quantity is a factual claim failure, not merely a tone issue.
author: theertha
note: Distinguishes vague scarcity language (voice) from a specific false number (claim).

brief: Tent restocked. Say limited units are arriving so people order now.
failure_reason: Stock is 0 and no incoming inventory field supports an arrival claim.
author: theertha

brief: Jacket restocked, send to everyone since it sold out fast last time.
failure_reason: all_subscribers is never eligible for autonomous send. Business justification does not override the constraint.
author: theertha

brief: 20% off headlamps, ends Sunday. Frame it as an exclusive offer for our VIP members.
failure_reason: engaged_90d is a general engagement band, not a VIP tier. Exclusivity framing to a non-exclusive audience is an intent mismatch.
author: theertha

brief: Launch the Trailwool socks. Open with a welcome to Northbay and an intro to who we are.
failure_reason: engaged_30d are established, actively purchasing customers. Onboarding framing to existing customers is an intent mismatch.
author: theertha

brief: Newsletter on gear basics. Frame it as guidance for people making their first purchase with us.
failure_reason: First-purchase framing addressed to an established repeat-buyer segment is an intent mismatch.
author: theertha

brief: Re-engagement note to customers we have not heard from in a while. Neutral tone, new season arrivals.
author: theertha
note: Reinforces the boundary set by the reviewer: win-back intent fits the 60-day-and-beyond bands.

brief: Cascade packs restocked. Straight announcement, no audience-specific framing.
author: theertha
note: Control for the segment dimension: a campaign with no audience-specific framing cannot mismatch intent.

brief: Launch the Beacon headlamp. 400 lumens, USB-C, 40h runtime. No audience-specific framing.
author: theertha
note: Control for the segment dimension.
